claims.claim: For a finite tested nutrient-dose and context panel with stationary directly measured resource-use and net target-suppression rates, exact finite-horizon reachability is characterized by a linear feasibility problem over dose-occupation fractions; confidence bounds give a conservative certificate.
assumptions: rate interface is stationary over the assay horizon
pulse order has no unmeasured effect
concentration clamp transitions are negligible or charged
contexts are exactly the finite declared panel
upper resource and lower suppression confidence bounds are valid

claims.claim: For one context, any point on the resource-versus-suppression upper frontier over a finite dose grid can be represented with at most two nutrient levels.
assumptions: stationary rate interface
time sharing is additive
transition costs are measured or negligible

claims.claim: A cellobiose concentration floor is forward invariant under a measured supply condition; if target-cell cellobiose uptake is zero in the declared panel, target burden does not appear in the supply lower bound.
assumptions: mass balance is correct
uptake and loss envelopes hold above the floor
cellobiose target-uptake upper bound is established for every declared context

claims.claim: For a shared nutrient with positive competitor uptake and no finite competitor-density bound, no finite supply certifies a positive concentration floor uniformly; a private-substrate gate removes that competitor term.
assumptions: positive competitor uptake at the proposed concentration floor
competitor density is unbounded in the uncertainty set
private-fuel uptake upper bound is zero in the private-fuel case

claims.claim: For a finite staged state/action interface with directly measured successor sets, upper nutrient-input vectors, and lower log-suppression increments, backward robust dynamic programming exactly characterizes reachability when the interface is exact and gives a sufficient certificate with valid confidence enclosures.
assumptions: finite stage, state, and action sets
all possible transitions are included in the measured successor sets
nutrient-cost upper bounds and suppression lower bounds hold uniformly on each interface row
state feedback is used only when the state bin is observable at the decision boundary
unobserved context uncertainty is included adversarially

claims.claim: An early methionine state-write followed by later CDT-1/GH1-1 cellobiose fueling may produce a robust immune-cell state-control advantage under glucose limitation.
assumptions: early methionine pulse effect transfers to the selected CAR-T activation protocol
a directly measured early state marker predicts later functional response
cellobiose flux and target suppression remain favorable after priming
the measured state/context transition bounds transfer to held-out donors
claims.evidence: TEMPORAL_STATE_CONTROL.md; separate source results in SOURCES.md

claims.claim: CDT-1/GH1-1-engineered T cells can use cellobiose under glucose withdrawal and show improved functional outcomes in the systems tested by Miller et al. (2026).
claims.scope_limit: Does not certify every tumor, tissue, microbiome, dose, or clinical setting.

claims.claim: Sharma et al. report that 0.03 mM versus 0.1 mM methionine during the first 30 minutes of TCR engagement changes later T-cell signaling/state after methionine is restored; the paper's Fig. 5j survival dataset was corrected in 2026.
claims.scope_limit: Supports measuring pulse-order and state; does not establish a combined methionine/cellobiose benefit. Use the corrected Fig. 5j when citing that survival result.

claims.claim: The application-specific robust frontier/finite-context design certificate is historically novel.
claims.reason: Convex occupation measures and resource-balance barriers are standard; no priority search or external review was performed.

primary_falsifier: In a held-out paired coculture, after direct uptake, mass-balance, exclusivity, and schedule-order gates pass, a target-count ratio above the certified bound refutes the model-to-biology map.
costs_not_hidden: independent donor blocks and matched target cultures
direct substrate uptake and concentration measurements
glucose/fructose/cellobiose nutrient inputs reported separately and in carbon equivalents
in-vivo pharmacokinetic and animal costs if subsequently attempted
evidence_status: No wet-lab experiment or source-data reanalysis was performed in this cycle.
